records.text: Bill Gates appears in the Epstein files
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Look, Elon Musk seems like a nice guy, but do I believe he's running 17 trillion air dollar companies at the same time while also having 49 baby mamas? No, I don't. I don't accept that. Bill Gates, that one bothers me the most. Oh my God, shocker. He's in the Epstein files.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Current AP reporting based on released Epstein records documents Gates in calendars, emails, and photographs connected to Epstein; appearance in the files does not itself imply wrongdoing.

sources.title: Bill Gates appears in Epstein records released by House committee
sources.relevance: Current AP reporting documents Gates references in released Epstein records.

records.text: Bill Gates went from computers to pharmaceuticals to poisoning African children
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: You really think this guy is just such a genius? He went from computers to pharmaceuticals to poisoning African kids.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. The accusation is vague and supplies no event, product, dose, victim set, or causal evidence. Current fact checks reject prominent versions of Gates-vaccine harm claims, but this wording is too indefinite for a conclusive true/false finding.
